title: Prove sharp scalar ranges for the fixed role-1256 graph
body:
This proof gives the sharp normalized scalar ranges for the fixed role-1256 graph in [PR #7704](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7704). Its largest ordered row prefix is `53895757/256` for independent unit-bounded entrances. The source's sum of separate product bounds is `13819451/16`. Keeping the cancellations between repeated entrance contributions gives the sharper value. **No new kappa** or selected-frontier change follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/762a4d8c541081be987f2fdf9053d4d7b52990f4/research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range/PROOF.md), [exact receipt and attaining inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/762a4d8c541081be987f2fdf9053d4d7b52990f4/research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/762a4d8c541081be987f2fdf9053d4d7b52990f4/research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range/verify.py) and [source credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/762a4d8c541081be987f2fdf9053d4d7b52990f4/research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range/CREDITS.md).

| Quantity | Exact maximum for unit-bounded entrances | Extra signed bits |
|---|---:|---:|
| Completed row or entrance | `2140811/96` | 15 |
| Ordered partial sum | `53895757/256` | 18 |
| Separate rational product | `4340699/24` | 18 |
| Integer numerator before division | `36262265/32` | 21 |

The domain fixes all 1501 independent entrances, scalar rows, coefficients and donor order of graph `8e7b755bd2d2d387bc3d3adfe48100985adf74775ca5acbb143170a3d16b5ccf`. The l1 norm of each entrance coefficient vector proves its range for every real input in the cube; the matching input signs attain it. A paid move is the identity only in these normalized scalar coordinates.

For signed W-bit integer entrances that are multiples of 921600, `W+21` data bits suffice for the stated scalar arithmetic. A reachable 32-bit fixture produces numerator `2433343030560000`, above the `W+20` positive limit `2251799813685247`. Thus the product and prefix bounds alone miss a real overflow condition. The largest prefix occurs in terminal row 156140, which eventually cancels to entrance 1372. Completed-row bounds alone also miss it.

The source's physical `W+26` service has a different W contract. This result does not replace that service bound. Physical chart operators, child interiors, common-root precision, tape implementation and compiler cost remain separate. All five selected assumptions remain; the selected kappa stays `0.00363005817`. The full source endpoint theorem, caller invoice and physical application are not certified here.

The base is current main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The consumed graph is from @Clear1nsight's exact head `e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93`: [graph](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/data/CANDIDATE-GRAPH.json.gz), [physical analysis](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/PHYSICAL.md), [source checker](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/physical.py), [source receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/evidence/PHYSICAL.json). The graph bytes, license and original notices are retained. The source verifier is not imported.

Credit @SYLforge for the nine-swap word in [PR #7700](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7700), as recorded in the [source notice](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/NOTICE). It retains the contributions of DreamingOfClouds, Ali Romman, Rohan Arun, Jerry Chen, Douglas Colkitt and the bank/caller/framework lineage. Ali Romman's [PR #7702](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7702) supplies related [row-atomic arithmetic](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/785860501b03893eaa9f5279f978287e75d3f3af/research/chart595-row-atomic-arithmetic/PROOF.md) on a different graph and donor contract; its bound is not consumed. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

With CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range
```

Both normal and optimized commands print:

```text
PASS_RELAY1256_SHARP_SCALAR_RANGE
7644 rows; 172414 prefixes; 9044092 basis products; 8 scalar oracle runs
Extra signed bits: snapshots 15; prefixes 18; products 18; numerators 21
```

All 172414 prefixes and 9044092 nonzero basis products are checked. Eight complete scalar oracles attain the four maxima over rational and integer inputs, with four one-bit-smaller failure witnesses. Source bytes, chronology, charts, exact divisions and the source triangle bound are checked. Local normal/optimized replay, committed-byte/mode and source-history checks, export and sealed Git-free replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44324245851/job/134871107618) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, native/physical replay, Lean, Docker, human and formal-kernel review were not run.

The [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19710477) takes the scalar-range sub-obligation. Live source/phrase overlap and the closed delta were checked. The concurrent sender/receiver work is now published as [PR #7708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7708), current head `7017edbe4bc5ed1b6d5b6defedbc7e472d83c65c`. It changes the graph and keeps a no-cancellation common-root guard. This audit retains the graph supplied in [PR #7704](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7704); its exact numerical bounds do not transfer automatically to #7708. It changes no row or invoice. Sparse local and unpublished work remain overlap limits. The [README](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/762a4d8c541081be987f2fdf9053d4d7b52990f4/research/relay1256-sharp-scalar-range/README.md) states the open physical-promotion questions.
